motifs.name: eye_space_potential_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more 2x2 blocks with at least 2 stones of their color and at least 1 empty point, indicating eye-making potential.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'eye_space_potential_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The evaluated color has more 2x2 blocks with at least 2 stones of their color and at least 1 empty point, indicating eye-making potential.'

def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    color_potential = 0
    opp_potential = 0
    
    for r in range(18):
        for c in range(18):
            s00 = board_rows[r][c]
            s01 = board_rows[r][c+1]
            s10 = board_rows[r+1][c]
            s11 = board_rows[r+1][c+1]
            
            color_count = (s00 == color) + (s01 == color) + (s10 == color) + (s11 == color)
            opp_count = (s00 == opp) + (s01 == opp) + (s10 == opp) + (s11 == opp)
            empty_count = (s00 == '.') + (s01 == '.') + (s10 == '.') + (s11 == '.')
            
            if color_count >= 2 and empty_count >= 1:
                color_potential += 1
            if opp_count >= 2 and empty_count >= 1:
                opp_potential += 1
    
    return color_potential > opp_potential

motifs.name: unpressed_diagonal_advantage

motifs.name: diagonal_connection_advantage

motifs.name: open_quarter_advantage

motifs.name: influence_line_advantage

motifs.name: balanced_shape_advantage

motifs.name: liberty_rich_advantage

motifs.name: solid_connection_advantage

motifs.name: expansion_directions_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more stones on lines 3-4 from edges with empty space in 2+ cardinal directions toward center, indicating multi-directional expansion potential.

motifs.name: corner_territory_advantage

motifs.name: framework_base_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more stones on the 3rd-4th lines with empty space toward center and same-color support toward the edge, indicating good framework bases.

motifs.name: cutting_point_potential_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more empty points adjacent to both colors where placing a stone would cut between opponent groups, indicating fighting advantage.

motifs.name: outward_facing_advantage

motifs.name: directional_liberty_advantage

motifs.name: shared_liberty_efficiency_advantage

motifs.name: side_base_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more 3rd-line skipped pairs (two stones with one empty space between) on the sides, indicating stable territorial bases.

motifs.name: knight_jump_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more knight-jump stone pairs (1-2 or 2-1 diagonal offset), indicating efficient flexible shape.

motifs.name: adjacent_empty_advantage

motifs.name: group_vitality_advantage

motifs.name: diagonal_liberty_fork_advantage

motifs.name: expansion_potential_advantage

motifs.name: fourth_line_advantage

motifs.name: well_connected_stone_advantage

motifs.name: edge_presence_advantage

motifs.name: center_control_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has more stones in the center region (rows 6-12, cols 6-12) than the opponent.

motifs.name: effective_cutting_density_advantage
motifs.description: The evaluated color has a higher density of effective cutting stones (cutting opponent with some freedom) than the opponent.

motifs.name: diagonal_flexibility_advantage

motifs.name: pair_connection_advantage
